tasks.label: Mobile: Prebuild Android (apply plugins)
tasks.detail: Regenerates the android/ folder from app.json + plugins/. MUST run before any Gradle build — otherwise Gradle silently builds whatever was in android/ last time, which may predate the cert-pinning/release-signing plugins or an updated certs/backend-ca.pem. Requires RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PATH, RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS, RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD to be set as environment variables for a real release-signed output (see certs/README.md and plugins/withReleaseSigning.js) — without them this still succeeds but falls back to debug signing.

tasks.label: Mobile: Build Release AAB (Play Store)
tasks.detail: Builds the Android App Bundle (.aab) at android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab for Play Console upload. Always runs prebuild first (see dependsOn) so it can't silently build from a stale android/ folder. NOTE: bundleRelease, not assembleRelease — Play Console requires an .aab for new apps, not a raw .apk.

tasks.label: Mobile: Build Sideload APK (local testing only — NOT for Play Store)
tasks.detail: Builds a plain .apk for directly installing on one tablet to test (adb install / file transfer), bypassing Play Store entirely. Fine for quick local testing even without release-signing env vars set (Android allows installing a debug-signed APK directly — only Play Console rejects it). Do NOT upload this file to Play Console.
